sources.used_for: Required/optional parameters and repeated values bound to lists and arrays.
defaultValue applies to missing or empty values; a default makes the parameter optional.
Named-value resolution, defaults, conversion, and missing-after-conversion checks precede method invocation.
Native integer widths, whitespace removal, decimal and hex number parsing.
Boolean converter accepts true/on/yes/1 and false/off/no/0, with trimming.
Array-to-scalar conversion uses the first occurrence.
Multiple String values become a comma-delimited string.
A single string is comma-delimited for collection conversion.
RestTemplate retains URI_COMPONENT for compatibility; component encoding differs from strict variable encoding.
parsePath defaults true for URI_COMPONENT; slash in a template path variable is encoded.
Parameterized logging can defer a user toString callback; a method name does not prove no side effects.
Facade permits deployment-time logging backends; purity was not inferred.

verification: Context7 and official Spring documentation/source. No framework/server was run.
scope: Bounded default Spring MVC/RestTemplate semantics; detected custom configuration is unresolved.
